incidents.description: An initial Claude attempt was stopped after shell redirection was blocked, before any successful send.

Claude sent successfully, but status discarded the leader conversation when no launcher task was open. A failing regression reproduced it; the fix exposed the existing reply. The same native Claude session resumed with read-only checks and did not resend.
An initial Codex invocation combined mutually exclusive --sandbox and --approve-for-me flags. It exited before a native agent session or OMB bot turn.

The valid Codex session could not reach loopback during its first server doctor inside workspace-write (exit 3). The exact command passed after approval review allowed escalation; subsequent network commands used escalation.

regression.beforeFix: failed on missing no-run leader field

fullSuite.execution: outside the socket-restricted sandbox after the source fix
